diagrams.title: Recover collection under the original lock and global fence
diagrams.caption: Future coordinator storage and recovery obligations across three proposed fixed-image containers. Terminal storage holds the original lock, fences, bindings and lifecycle/final rows. Attempts use their assigned backing. Recovery burns uncertain ordinals and permits collection only. S1 tests storage with fixed byte objects. S2-S6 require the implemented coordinator. No metadata, durability or recovery result is established.

diagrams.title: Complete the approved dependency design path
diagrams.caption: Design work sequence, not runtime authority. Both human decisions are settled. Contract review and integration come before the native/storage qualification proposal and its separate review and execution decision. Required evidence includes a suitable external dependency, launcher, native and storage coverage; missing evidence keeps the profile unavailable. The original numerical/workload/timing/schema obligations and whole-design review remain.

diagrams.title: Bound producer work before allocation and write
diagrams.caption: Proposed dependency interface after complete profile qualification. Read from the first owner transition. The producer launcher checks the declared environment and binds bounded raw descriptors before execution. The request pins encoding and OCR choices. Producer guards cover allocations and structured emission. Backend capture covers abnormal raw output and inherited holders. Original and partial outputs survive failure. The qualification proposal retains pipes and a separately pinned collector as candidates. Queue bounds, bootstrap and process-loss retention remain unqualified. Copied collector barriers and write-result substitutions are outside the approval. Delivery and terminal completion use the full owner protocol, abbreviated here. No implemented API or enforcement result follows.

diagrams.title: Establish resources before producer execution
diagrams.caption: Proposed resource admission under one writer authority. Admission checks without an operation charge. The commitment transition charges before directory reservation and publication. Producer launcher enforcement follows commitment and precedes external execution, including environment checks and bounded raw descriptors. Setup refusal retains the committed attempt and charge. The approved design path is a bounded producer with separately qualified runtime and storage; none is implemented or qualified here. Collection-backed directories and terminal-backed ordinal records remain requirements. The view omits stop cancellation and detailed lifecycle joins. The complete numerical profile remains unavailable.

diagrams.title: Serve the oldest request within its deadline
diagrams.caption: Proposed scheduling contract. The owner checks failure, stop and expiry before commitment. Full capture qualification and terminal delivery precede later dispatch. Operation bounds are 52, 67 or 142 seconds; local records use 22. Resource limits and workload qualification remain outstanding. The graph omits detailed normal-stop joins, shown in the lifecycle view. No native idle safety or model checking is claimed.

diagrams.title: One owner controls dispatch and evidence
diagrams.caption: Arrows show ownership, submission and control, and numbered edges mark startup and dispatch entry. The owner authorises operations and writes lifecycle records. Its backend child writes command receipts and the sticky latch under the same lock. The finite caller can take collection-only ownership after owner loss and resolved holders. It never restores scenario eligibility. Scheduling is proposed. Enforceable resources, whole-design review and implementation remain outstanding.

diagrams.title: Normal stop preserves every committed capture
diagrams.caption: Proposed worker lifecycle. This state view starts at the initial dot. Normal stop never interrupts sleep20, clears failure or replaces a capture. Complete disposition requires backend validation, payload acknowledgement, terminal publication and a completion frame. The scheduling proposal supplies stop and reap deadlines. Enforceable resources remain unresolved. No native idle interval is established.

diagrams.title: A due capture conflicts with the whole-operation writer
diagrams.caption: Current semantics under a permitted schedule. Twenty seconds is sleep after completion. A live OCR connection maintains VNC activity during that part of the lock hold; validation after CLI exit does not. No collision rate or whole-command deadline follows.

diagrams.title: Agreed timing, evidence, stop and resource scope
diagrams.caption: Antony approved further design of UI-independent ownership delays and deferred ticks, a finite resource profile, and a matched normal-stop lifecycle result. Full capture validation before later dispatch and prior failures remain binding. Limits, policies and schemas remain outstanding; no liveness-only exemption, new native experiment or runtime is authorized.

diagrams.title: Why the current probe does not discriminate cause
diagrams.caption: Appearance, main-resignation and front/resume observations do not identify a matched intervention. Qualified failures can refute row-click or marker necessity only when absence is independently established; the broad rivals have no finite falsifier.

diagrams.title: Accepted scope for repair design
diagrams.caption: The named empirical scope is approved. One local reversal, two focused and three complete ordinary guests use one unchanged candidate with diagnostics disabled. The application compiles. The separately approved keepalive scope permits only UI-independent ownership waits; its concrete design/review and all shared harness repairs precede freeze. Causal slots remain held; no signed subject or result exists.

diagrams.title: Assessed original path and the implemented empirical candidate
diagrams.caption: The numbered path is the assessed original order; the dotted edge enters reasoning. Both orders previously succeeded with synchronous file tracing. The reviewed reversal now compiles and passes existing headless controls. Shared harness repairs and runtime acceptance remain live; no comparative risk or cause is established.

diagrams.title: Prepare one window, activate once, then order it
diagrams.caption: Implemented synchronous application order, including readiness failure. The window is constructed and navigation applied before activation. A return does not imply activation completed; the OS may decline. Launch, reopen and both menu callers share this owner. No retry, yielding or deferral is added.

diagrams.title: Two focused guests before three complete ordinary guests
diagrams.caption: E01/E02 and A01/A02/A03 are serial fresh slots using one frozen candidate with diagnostics disabled and the same repaired scenario/helpers. Setup, title and liveness rules separate recurrence from process loss and unavailable evidence. Failed transport stops acceptance, including restart disconnect. Screenshots retain context. Audit and exact cleanup remain required; passing covers only the sample. No baseline, replacement or expansion.
